method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading and reverse paraphrase of K_0 and K constructions, with exact formula, macro, label and reference parity. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Computably enumerable yet noncomputable halting set K_0 and c.e. yet undecidable self-halting set K.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: K_0 consists of codes of pairs (e,x) for which φ_e(x) is defined. It is c.e. because a partial µ-search on y finds a T-witness exactly for valid pair codes with a halting computation, and undefined otherwise. Its noncomputability follows from the previously proved halting-problem undecidability.
samples.checks: The pair-length-two test, both definedness cases, invalid-pair case and cross-reference remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: K_0 is the halting set, and K is the self-halting set of indices e for which φ_e(e) is defined. K is c.e. but not decidable: if its characteristic function were computable, a partial d returning one exactly when e is outside K would have an index k, yielding d(k) defined iff φ_k(k) undefined although d≃φ_k. K is c.e. because it is the domain of µ_y T(x,x,y).
samples.checks: The self-input e, characteristic-function zero test, opposite definedness, c.e. domain construction, labels and every displayed formula are preserved.

source_observations: T327 supplies the effective-enumeration compound and T322 the established halting terminology; the K_0/K constructions themselves are fixed by OpenLogic.
The frozen !!{c.e.} tokens are preserved exactly as source-controlled markup.
limitations: The Marathi names for halting and self-halting sets are transparent source-controlled phrases, not independently attested headwords.
No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
